claim_boundary: This audit repairs the dense-torus common-zero inference for all 600 overlapping (2,3)/(3,2) nilpotent rows.
It uses saved exact determinant factorizations and does not infer torus emptiness from a multivariate gcd alone.
It does not audit higher-parameter overlap-two certificates and does not prove ordinary lower 50, exact rank 64, or border rank.
proof_method: Remove the invertible Laurent monomial, verify that w disappears from every residual and that the residual lies in Q[r*t], then compute the exact univariate gcd. Gcd 1 supplies the Bezout certificate for an empty common zero set on the torus.
